第25章 我才是这荒古大陆第一天才（第1页）
看著从眼前摔门而出，直奔外门弟子试炼所在地的楚尘，张可儿半张著嘴，半天都没反应过来。
张可儿把头摇得跟拨浪鼓似的，这可是师尊的男人，可不能瞎惦记
默念几遍女帝师尊传给自己的“孤女心经”后，张可儿那颗躁动不安的心，这才稍稍平息下来。
而后张可儿脚踩著飞剑，再一次遇见飞向女帝帝宫。
楚尘已经安顿好了，能不能通过外门弟子试炼，顺利进入神焰帝宫便看他自己的造化了。
女帝师尊闭关这段时间，她张可儿需寸步不离守在帝宫门口，將一切来覲见、探查之人，悉数拦在宫门外。
与此同时，楚尘出了紫竹林，然后按照路牌所指，走向外门弟子试炼所在地。
体內被毁的经脉重塑，便意味著楚尘可以修炼了。
大道之伤被治癒，油尽灯枯的身体重新焕发出新的生机来。
用活出第二世来形容，一点都不为过。
虽然不知道张可儿所说的神凰羽翎】为何物，但有如此逆天改命之功效，其价值绝不在传说中的帝境不死药之下。
早知如此，上辈子何至於在叶家当一条狗，活活把自己委屈死。
对如今的他来说，什么家族羈绊、什么父子情深、姐妹兄弟情谊
对自己恶的，管踏马是谁，以牙还牙、以眼还眼，直接干回去！
女帝林书望对他有救命之恩，他楚尘日后自是要加倍还回去。
不是仗著有叶轩在，就可以坐稳不朽世家的位置，让整个叶家再度崛起？
思索间，楚尘三步並作两步走，按照路牌所指，下了紫竹林后，一路向南，直抵赤王山。
外门弟子试炼场所，便是在这赤王山山门口。
好在此地距离紫竹林並不远，即便靠一双脚，不用半个时辰，也能抵达。
这几天是神焰帝宫开山收徒的日子，附近所有修行奇才、隱士天骄，世家子弟等等，但凡符合要求的，都赶来赤王山参加外门弟子试炼，幻想著能够顺利进入神焰帝宫，逆天改命！
所以，等楚尘赶到赤王山山门口时，一眼望去，黑压压的一大片人，可谓是人山人海，著实嚇了一跳。
女帝林书望乃神焰帝宫之主，以她的身份和地位，一个眼神、一句话，楚尘便可轻轻鬆鬆顺利进入神焰帝宫，而且地位极高。
甚至都不需要女帝出面，她的那个傻徒弟张可儿就可以把一切安排得妥妥噹噹。
可女帝偏偏没有这样做，而是交给楚尘一块令牌，让其跟其他想要进入神焰帝宫的世家子弟一样，参加外门弟子试炼。
紧了紧手里的令牌，楚尘大抵能猜出女帝林书望的目的。
这是给自己留足时间，猥琐发育，以防止被其他人针对。
毕竟他楚尘的名声太盛，如今重续修行路，一上来就跟女帝走得太近的话，容易招人妒忌，被人陷害。
加之女帝林书望为了给自己疗伤，不惜拼得境界下跌，强行闭关，这神焰帝宫，可没人护著自己。
总之一句话，女帝是在保护他楚尘。
女帝所谋是不错，但他楚尘也不是任人拿捏的软柿子。
身怀极道帝兵吞天魔罐，如今又重续修行路，即便想低调，也註定低调不了。

Chapter 25 I am the number one genius in this ancient continent (page 1)
Seeing Chu Chen slamming out the door in front of him and heading straight to the location where the outer disciples were being tested, Zhang Keer opened his mouth half-open and didn't react for a long time.
Zhang Ke'er shook his head like a rattle. This is Master's man, so he can't dwell on it blindly.
After silently reciting the "Orphan Girl's Heart Sutra" passed down to him by the Empress Master several times, Zhang Ke'er's restless heart finally calmed down a little.
Then Zhang Keer stepped on the flying sword and met flying towards the Empress' Palace again.
Chu Chen has settled in. Whether he can pass the outer disciple test and successfully enter the Divine Flame Emperor's Palace depends on his own destiny.
During the period when the Empress Master is in seclusion, she, Zhang Keer, must stay at the entrance of the imperial palace and block all those who come to see or investigate.
At the same time, Chu Chen came out of the Purple Bamboo Forest and followed the road signs to the location where the outer disciples were undergoing trials.
The reconstruction of the destroyed meridians in the body meant that Chu Chen could practice.
The wounds of the great road were healed, and the body that had run out of oil and lamps was filled with new vitality.
To describe it as living a second life is not an exaggeration at all.
Although I don’t know what the Divine Phoenix Feather that Zhang Ke’er mentioned is, but it has such a heaven-defying effect of changing life, its value is by no means inferior to the legendary Emperor Realm elixir.
If I had known this, why would I have been a dog in the Ye family in my previous life and tortured myself to death.
For him today, what is the family bond, the deep love between father and son, and the love between sisters and brothers?
Whoever is evil to you, no matter who is stepping on the horse, just go back with a tooth for a tooth, an eye for an eye!
Empress Lin Shuwang had saved his life, and he, Chu Chen, would definitely repay him twice as much in the future.
Wouldn't it be possible to secure the position of the Immortal Family with Ye Xuan's presence and allow the entire Ye family to rise again?
While thinking, Chu Chen took three steps at a time and then two steps at a time. Following the directions of the road signs, he descended into the Purple Bamboo Forest and headed south until he reached Chiwang Mountain.
The training place for outer disciples is at the gate of Chiwang Mountain.
Fortunately, this place is not far from the Purple Bamboo Forest. You can reach it in less than half an hour even with a pair of feet.
These days are the days when the Divine Flame Emperor's Palace opens its doors to accept disciples. All the nearby cultivation wizards, hermit geniuses, children of aristocratic families, etc., who meet the requirements, come to Chiwang Mountain to participate in the outer disciple trial, dreaming of successfully entering the Divine Flame Emperor's Palace and changing their fate against the will of heaven!
Therefore, when Chu Chen arrived at the gate of Chiwang Mountain, he was really shocked when he saw a large, dark mass of people. It could be described as a sea of ​​people.
Empress Lin Shuwang is the master of the Divine Flame Emperor's Palace. With her identity and status, Chu Chen can easily and smoothly enter the Divine Flame Emperor's Palace with just one look and a word, and her status is extremely high.
The empress didn't even need to come forward, her stupid apprentice Zhang Keer could arrange everything properly.
But the Empress did not do this. Instead, she gave Chu Chen a token and asked him to participate in the Outer Disciple Trial like other children from aristocratic families who wanted to enter the Divine Flame Emperor's Palace.
Holding the token in his hand tightly, Chu Chen could probably guess the purpose of Empress Lin Shuwang.
This is to give yourself enough time to develop in order to prevent being targeted by others.
After all, Chu Chen's reputation is too great. Now that he is resuming his cultivation path, if he gets too close to the empress from the beginning, he will easily attract jealousy and be framed.
In addition, in order to heal herself, the empress Lin Shuwang did not hesitate to suffer a decline in her realm and forced herself into seclusion. There was no one to protect her in the Divine Flame Emperor's Palace.
In short, the empress was protecting him, Chu Chen.
The empress's plan was good, but he, Chu Chen, was not a soft persimmon who could be manipulated by others.
He possesses the Heaven-Swallowing Demonic Jar of the Supreme Dao Emperor Soldier, and now resumes his cultivation path. Even if he wants to keep a low profile, he is destined to be unable to keep a low profile.
